expected:
Detective Hwang walked around it twice before she said anything. “No skid marks. No damage. Keys in the ignition.”

“Maybe he ran out of gas,” Pruitt offered.

Hwang leaned in through the open window and tapped the gauge. “Three quarters full.”

“Okay, so maybe he just wanted to walk.”

“In January? In his socks?” She held up a pair of shoes from the footwell.

context: Grandma Ruth had been dead for nine years, so the voicemail was something of a surprise.
raw: Um, it's me, the message said. Don't hang up. I know this is, uh, irregular. I need you to go to the attic and find the blue hatbox, the one with the the cracked lid, and I need you to do it before your Uncle Leo gets there, because he will throw it out, he throws everything out. There was a pause, and a sound like a kettle. That's all. Love you, sweet pea.
